general.record_mode_hint: Hold — speak while the key is down. Toggle — press once to start, again to stop.
general.insert_method_hint: “Type” is for apps that don't accept paste.
general.speech_language_hint: A hint for recognition. “Auto” detects the language.
general.cleanup_hint: Removes “um”, “uh” and repeats, adds punctuation. Never changes the meaning.
hotkeys.title: Keys
hotkeys.subtitle: Hold a key and speak. Release it and the text appears at the cursor.
hotkeys.dictation_hint: Text in the language you speak
hotkeys.translate_hint: English text in the chosen style
translate.title: Translation
translate.subtitle: Speak any language — English text is inserted.

translate.example_casual: Hey, can you send me the report by Friday? Thanks!
provider.title: Provider
provider.subtitle: Speech is recognised in the chosen service's cloud with your own key. There are no Utter servers.
provider.openai_caption: Pay as you go — not a ChatGPT subscription
history.title: History
history.subtitle: The last 50 recordings. Stored only on this Mac.
history.empty: Your dictations and translations will appear here
about.title: About
about.diagnostics_hint: Version, system, settings without keys and recent log lines — for a bug report.
onboarding.welcome_body: Hold a key and speak. The text appears by itself.
onboarding.mic_body: Utter listens only while the key is held.
onboarding.mic_denied: Access denied — turn Utter on in the microphone settings.
onboarding.ax_body: Turn Utter on in the window that opens.
onboarding.ax_waiting: Waiting for you to turn it on…
onboarding.provider_body: Takes a minute. All you need is a Google account.
permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: Without these Utter can't record or insert text.
onboarding.demo_1_src: Hola, ¿me puedes mandar el informe antes del viernes?
onboarding.demo_1_dst: Hi, could you send me the report by Friday?
onboarding.demo_2_src: Compra leche y pan de camino a casa, por favor
onboarding.demo_2_dst: Could you grab some milk and bread on your way home?
onboarding.demo_3_src: Pasemos la llamada a mañana a las diez
onboarding.demo_3_dst: Let's move the call to tomorrow at 10 a.m.
onboarding.demo_4_src: Revisa el contrato antes del fin de semana, sobre todo la cláusula de pago
onboarding.demo_4_dst: Please review the contract by the end of the week, especially the payment terms.
onboarding.key_return: Come back here — the key goes in by itself
about.drop_body: It lives by your Mac's notch. Hold the key and Drop wakes up and listens, swaying to your voice. Let go — it thinks for a second and puts the text where your cursor is. When it works, Drop smiles; when something goes wrong, it sulks under a little cloud.
